subject: Post-discovery: propose 60-90m ML/Infra deep-dive & calendar options
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
To: Jessica Park <jessica@nimhealth.com>, Alan Taylor <alan.taylor@nimhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: propose 60-90m ML/Infra deep-dive & calendar options

Hi Jessica / Alan —

Great to meet earlier — thanks for taking the time. Quick recap from our call and a tight set of options to lock the next step (technical deep-dive with our ML + infra team, 60–90 minutes):

Call recap (2 bullets):
- Main goal: validate end-to-end latency/cost for your ingestion -> embedding -> rerank flow and review security boundaries (SSO, data retention).
- Key stakeholders to include: your ML lead + infra/ops owner + our ML infra engineers.

Proposed session scope (60–90m):
- 10m: goals & success criteria
- 25–40m: architecture & integration walk-through (prefix caching, batching, routing)
- 20–30m: live perf patterns + expected throughput math for your 3 use cases
- 10m: questions / next steps (mutual action plan)

Availability windows (PDT) — pick any 1 or propose alternatives:
- Tue 8/31: 10:00–11:30 or 14:00–15:30
- Wed 9/1: 09:00–10:30 or 15:00–16:30
- Thu 9/2: 13:00–14:30

Who I suggest be on the call (please confirm):
- Jessica Park (Prospect, ML Lead) — your side
- Alan Taylor (Prospect, CTO) — your side
- Neha Kapoor (Redwood, Solutions Eng) — will own demos and security questions
- Rishi Malhotra (Redwood, Inference Eng) — will cover runtime & perf
- Marcus Lin (Redwood, Customer Success Engineer) — ops/runbook handoff

I attached a short draft agenda (tdx-proposed-agenda.docx) and a one-pager on what we'll benchmark. If you share preferred attendees and any mandatory compliance topics (SOC2 evidence, specific SSO provider details), we’ll fold them into the session.

Best,

Ava Chen
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ava@redwood.com
attachments: tdx-proposed-agenda.docx

Hi Ava —

Thanks — this is helpful. We’re aligned on the goals. Quick notes:
- We definitely want Rishi to show the latency/kv-cache behavior; Alan would like the routing/fallback discussion included.
- Compliance: SOC 2 evidence is on our checklist — I'll send the exact items in a follow-up, but please flag if your team needs specific artifacts ahead of the call.

Attendees from our side (confirmed):
- Jessica Park (ML Lead)
- Alan Taylor (CTO)
- Priya Mehta (Infra Lead) <priya.m@nimhealth.com> — prefers mornings

Availability (PDT) that works for the core group:
- Wed 9/1: 09:00–10:30 (best)
- Tue 8/31: 14:00–15:30 (possible)

One ask: can you include a short section showing how private deployments/VPC would change the memory/throughput tradeoffs? That’s a key gating item for us.

I attached an internal attendee list with titles (nimhealth-attendee-list.pdf).

Thanks,
Jessica
Senior ML Engineer | Nimbus Health
jessica@nimhealth.com

Jessica —

Perfect — appreciate the quick attendee list. Wed 9/1 09:00–10:30 PDT works for Rishi and Marcus as well. We'll plan for 75 minutes to cover the items you called out and leave time for SOC2 evidence questions.

A few prep items from our side so the session is productive:
- Could Priya share the SSO provider (Okta/AzureAD) and whether you want SSO flow diagrams ahead of time?
- If you have any sample payload sizes for embeddings (avg/min/max token lengths), that helps us size the batching and caching examples.

Agenda tweak: add a 10-minute segment after the architecture walk where we sketch the private deployment trade-offs (memory/quantization/batching) — Rishi will lead that.

I'll send a calendar invite once Jessica gives final confirmation; I'll include a short notes doc and the benchmarking one-pager.

Thanks — cc'ing Rishi and Marcus to confirm.

-Neha
